name: Tool — Agent-to-Agent (A2A)
summary: A2APreviewTool: invoke another Foundry agent as a tool from a BYOM-routed caller.
description: A2APreviewTool wired at a Foundry Prompt Agent whose `/agents/{name}/endpoint/protocols/a2a` endpoint was materialised by attaching an AgentCard via PATCH. Not in the official BYOM-supported tools list; tracked to verify whether cross-agent auth ever unlocks the full loop.
notes:
BYOM survives in the callee's model definition, but the caller-to-callee tool path is not working yet.

Foundry agents can be exposed as A2A servers via `PATCH /agents/{name}` with an AgentCard. The tool call from caller to callee returns 401 unless it is bound to a registered A2A connection with credentials.

Not in the official supported-tools list.
